items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was playing with Benny Carter at Disneyland, with Billy Eckstine

ctx.x: Linton Garner and Billy Strayhorn were friends from back in Pittsburgh, and Billy used to talk about Linton Garner.

Yeah. Yeah, they all came from Pittsburgh. We had a -- I was playing with Benny Carter at Disneyland, with Billy Eckstine, because I'd done some work for Billy Eckstine, you know, some conducting and album work with him.
